day_shape: 68 items: Netanyahu-Trump Washington meeting on Iran with Trump reiterating Pickaxe Mountain threats, Iran-backed Iraqi militia drones intercepted over Jordan and condemned by Saudi Arabia, Iran executes two protesters, UNSC quarterly Middle East debate, heavy IRGC/Defa Press messaging, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Netanyahu-Trump White House meeting on Iran
threads.summary: Trump hosted Netanyahu (alongside Zelensky) in Washington, reiterating threats against Iran's Pickaxe Mountain site and dismissing reports of a Netanyahu intelligence-sharing offer. Katz said US fighters and bombers had taken off from Israeli bases to strike Iran in recent weeks.

threads.label: Iraqi militia drones over Jordan and Gulf
threads.summary: The IDF intercepted three drones over Jordan on Monday and Tuesday, attributed by a source to Iran-backed Popular Mobilization Forces in Iraq, with Saudi Arabia's foreign ministry condemning the attacks. Jerusalem Post analysis reported Iran activating Iraqi militias against Saudi Arabia and Kurdistan.

threads.label: Caspian Sea vessel incident fallout
threads.summary: The Kremlin said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea should be treated as an assault on Iran. Defa Press quoted Commander Sanai-rad saying Ukraine's action would not go unanswered and characterising it as a proxy action for the United States.

threads.label: Iran executions and protest response
threads.summary: Iran executed two protesters arrested in January on charges of waging war against God, with Iran International reporting widespread grief and defiance. Jerusalem Post cited unverified reports of renewed protests.

threads.label: IRGC and defence ministry messaging
threads.summary: The acting defence minister said via Defa Press and IRIB that production lines were more active than before and that air and sea capabilities were strategic priorities. The IRGC Aerospace Force commander framed Iran's missile power as a trust from martyred commanders, and a Lady al-Zahra spokesman claimed vessels receiving Iranian blocked assets would be denied Strait passage.

threads.label: Gaza governance and reconstruction
threads.summary: Israel's security cabinet approved limited entry of a 200-troop International Stabilization Force under the Board of Peace-led Gaza plan, per Times of Israel. Oxfam put Gaza reconstruction at $71.4 billion over ten years, and the UN Security Council held its quarterly Middle East debate with briefings from Alakbarov and Mladenov.

threads.label: Lebanon and Islamic Jihad strikes
threads.summary: Israeli officials said IDF withdrawal from Lebanon was conditional on Hezbollah disarmament, while a Hezbollah-linked health group was reported still operating in a south Lebanon pilot zone. The IDF announced it killed Islamic Jihad Nukhba platoon commander Muhammad Khalil Muhammad Aslam in a Khan Younis strike on Monday.

Iran-Iraq relations cannot be understood without returning to 1979, the year when the triumph of the Islamic Revolution in Iran caused the entire political and security balance of the region to shift.
